answer: Social Matters >> Talaq (Divorce) Question ID: 146457 Country: India Title: Is it necessary to do iddah, if the husband and wife are separated for 10 years and wife want to take khula after marrying to another person? Question: Is it necessary to do iddah, if the husband and wife are separated for 10 years and wife want to take khula after marrying to another person? Answer ID: 146457 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 210/200/B=3/1438) Yes, if the husband gives khula to his wife then it is necessary to observe the iddah after khula. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
